spell.martial_spells.stillwater_meditati: Enter a state of deliberate stillness to restore Ki. Moving or attacking interrupts the meditation, while higher technique levels improve its resilience and restorative effects.
spell.martial_spells.flurry_of_blows.gui: Unleash two rapid strikes against an enemy directly in front of you. Damage scales from Attack Damage and Martial Spell Power, and the technique requires a valid Monk weapon.
spell.martial_spells.diamond_body.guide: Harden your body into an unyielding martial form, gaining armor, toughness, knockback resistance, and damage reduction. At higher mastery, Diamond Heart can prevent one lethal blow during the effect.
spell.martial_spells.stunning_strike.gui: Deliver a focused martial strike that damages and stuns the target while applying Rend II to weaken its armor. Some powerful enemies resist or are immune to the stun.
spell.martial_spells.deflect_missiles.gu: Assume a defensive stance that intercepts arrows, tridents, and fireballs while maintained. Incoming missiles are scattered away, with a level-scaled chance for eligible projectiles to be redirected toward their attacker.
spell.martial_spells.stillwater_meditati: Enter a state of deliberate stillness, gathering inner energy and restoring Ki upon completing the meditation.

spell.martial_spells.diamond_body.descri: Hardens the body into an unyielding martial form, granting armor, toughness, knockback resistance, and final damage reduction.

ui.martial_spells.diamond_body_heavy_res: Cannot be cast while wearing heavy armor.

ui.martial_spells.requires_stunning_stri: Requires empty hands, gauntlets, or a quarterstaff.
ui.martial_spells.no_stunning_strike_tar: No valid target is within striking range.

spell.martial_spells.step_of_the_wind.de: Move with supernatural speed, surging rapidly in the direction of your movement.
spell.martial_spells.step_of_the_wind.gu: Spend Ki to surge rapidly forward. Your aim provides limited vertical control, but the technique cannot be used while swimming, climbing, mounted, or flying.
ui.martial_spells.step_of_the_wind_inval: Step of the Wind cannot be used while mounted, swimming, climbing, or flying.
ui.martial_spells.step_of_the_wind_wall_: Run and climb along walls while Step remains active
Press Jump while wall-running to rebound away
ui.martial_spells.step_of_the_wind_fall_: Prevents fall damage from the protected movement
spell.martial_spells.heavenfall_strike.d: Launch into the air, choose a hostile target, and descend upon them with overwhelming martial force, unleashing a shockwave on impact.
spell.martial_spells.heavenfall_strike.g: Launch skyward and aim at a hostile creature until it is marked in gold, then press Attack to commit to Heavenfall and dive toward it. A successful impact deals heavy martial damage, applies Rend and Blight, briefly stuns the primary target, and releases a damaging shockwave that knocks nearby enemies away. Stun-resistant enemies suffer a shorter stun. Landing without committing or losing a valid target safely ends the technique.
ui.martial_spells.heavenfall_invalid_mov: Heavenfall Strike cannot be used while mounted, swimming, climbing, or flying.
ui.martial_spells.heavenfall_no_clearanc: There is not enough space above you to begin Heavenfall Strike.
ui.martial_spells.heavenfall_stun_durati: Stun Duration: %s seconds; halved against resistant enemies
spell.martial_spells.barrage.description: Loose a rapid sequence of martial arrows, with higher spell levels increasing both arrow count and damage.
spell.martial_spells.barrage.guide: Requires a bow or crossbow. Barrage fires 2 to 5 consecutive physical arrows depending on spell level. Each shot follows your current aim independently. Damage per arrow scales from 50% weapon damage at Common to 100% at Legendary before Martial Spell Power and other ranged modifiers are applied. Barrage always has a 6-second cooldown and is unaffected by Cooldown Reduction.
ui.martial_spells.barrage_requires_range: Barrage requires a bow or crossbow.
spell.martial_spells.entangling_arrow.de: Loose a martial arrow that binds a surviving target in grasping roots.
spell.martial_spells.entangling_arrow.gu: Requires a bow or crossbow. Entangling Arrow deals 50% to 100% weapon damage depending on spell level before Martial Spell Power and other ranged modifiers are applied. A surviving target that can be rooted is bound by Iron's Root for 2 to 6 seconds depending on spell level. Targets tagged as unable to be rooted still take the arrow damage. Its base cooldown is 15 seconds and Cooldown Reduction can lower it, but never below 7 seconds.
ui.martial_spells.entangling_arrow_requi: Entangling Arrow requires a bow or crossbow.
spell.martial_spells.caltrops.descriptio: Throw a bundle of caltrops that spreads into a damaging, slowing ground hazard.
spell.martial_spells.caltrops.guide: Instantly throw a bundle that deploys caltrops when it strikes a block. Grounded non-allied creatures inside the field take physical damage every 0.5 seconds and are slowed. The field is 3x3 blocks at Levels I-III, 4x4 at Level IV, and 5x5 at Level V. Damage scales with Martial Spell Power. Caltrops has a fixed 15-second cooldown that is unaffected by Cooldown Reduction.
spell.martial_spells.shock_powder.descri: Scatter electrified powder around you, stunning nearby enemies that can be overwhelmed.
spell.martial_spells.shock_powder.guide: Instantly releases shock powder in a 5-block area. Eligible non-allied targets are stunned for 2 seconds. Targets whose maximum health exceeds 50 + twice your current Attack Damage resist the control effect. Martial stun resistance and immunity rules still apply.
spell.martial_spells.shadow_step.descrip: Step through the shadows to appear behind a targeted enemy, briefly disrupting their ability to track you.
spell.martial_spells.shadow_step.guide: Requires a non-allied living target within 15 blocks. Shadowstep teleports you one block behind the target using its facing, then reduces hostile target-goal tracking range against you to 5 blocks for 1.5 seconds. The base cooldown is 12 seconds and can be reduced by Cooldown Reduction.
ui.martial_spells.shadow_step_blocked: There is no safe space behind that target.
spell.martial_spells.slice_and_dice.desc: Enter a battle trance. Each successful melee hit increases your attack damage for the trance's remaining duration.
spell.martial_spells.slice_and_dice.guid: Gain +10% base Attack Damage immediately for 10 seconds. Each successful player melee hit adds another +10% base Attack Damage, up to +100%. Hits do not refresh the original 10-second duration. Slice & Dice has a 15-second base cooldown and is affected by normal Cooldown Reduction.
spell.martial_spells.vanish.description: Vanish from sight, entering stealth until you act or are struck.
spell.martial_spells.vanish.guide: Enter Stealth for 8 seconds, becoming invisible to enemies while your base movement speed is reduced by 50%. Direct melee attacks, incoming hits, item use, or casting another Iron's spell ends Stealth immediately. Hostile target goals can only follow you from 1 block away while Stealth remains. Vanish has a 30-second base cooldown and is affected by normal Cooldown Reduction.
spell.martial_spells.bear_trap.descripti: Deploy three concealed traps around you that damage and root enemies who step on them.
spell.martial_spells.bear_trap.guide: Instantly deploys three traps 2 blocks from you at 120-degree intervals. Each trap arms after its deployment animation, lasts 20 seconds, and can trigger once. A triggered trap deals physical dual-melee damage with no added knockback and roots eligible targets for 3 seconds. Targets whose maximum health exceeds 100 + twice your translated dual-melee power resist the root. Bear Trap has a 15-second base cooldown and is affected by normal Cooldown Reduction.
spell.martial_spells.mutilate.descriptio: Cross-cut nearby enemies with both hands in a brutal forward melee strike.
spell.martial_spells.mutilate.guide: After half of your current melee attack cycle, Mutilate strikes eligible enemies in a 3-block, 160-degree forward arc. Each selected target receives one fully charged vanilla melee attack using your main-hand damage plus the frozen dual-melee offhand contribution, preserving normal weapon enchantments, critical hits, knockback and other melee hooks. An empty offhand still contributes the source framework's base unarmed Attack Damage. Mutilate has a 12-second base cooldown and is affected by normal Cooldown Reduction.
ui.martial_spells.mutilate_dual_damage: Damage: main-hand melee + offhand weapon/unarmed contribution
ui.martial_spells.mutilate_delay: Contact: %s%% of current melee attack cycle
spell.martial_spells.stillness_of_mind.d: Transcend the limits of Ki for a brief moment, allowing martial techniques to be used without consuming Ki.
spell.martial_spells.stillness_of_mind.g: Enter Stillness of Mind for 20 seconds. While active, Monk techniques do not consume Ki, though their normal cooldowns remain. Your Armor and Armor Toughness are reduced by 50%, but defensive techniques such as Diamond Body may still be used normally. Your stored Ki is preserved, and Ki gained during Stillness remains afterward. When Stillness ends, you suffer Weakness I for 60 seconds. Unequipping the Monk Codex ends the technique immediately.
ui.martial_spells.stillness_defense_pena: Armor and Armor Toughness reduced by 50% while active
ui.martial_spells.stillness_preserves_ki: Stored Ki is not consumed while active
ui.martial_spells.stillness_already_acti: Stillness of Mind is already active.
ui.martial_spells.stillness_requires_cod: Unequipping the Monk Codex ends Stillness immediately
effect.martial_spells.charge.description: Increases movement speed and knockback resistance.
spell.martial_spells.charge.description: Surge into battle with increased movement speed and resistance to knockback.
spell.martial_spells.charge.guide: Instantly grants +50% base Movement Speed and +50% base Knockback Resistance for 10 seconds. Recasting refreshes Charge instead of stacking another copy. Charge has a 12-second base cooldown and is affected by normal Cooldown Reduction.
Unleash a terrifying shout that weakens nearby enemies and deals a small amount of physical damage.

Shout at non-allied living targets within 12 blocks. Targets whose maximum health is at most 50 + twice your current Attack Damage gain Demoralized for 8 seconds. The first application is Demoralized I; repeated applications add one amplifier up to source cap 5 (Demoralized VI), with each effect level reducing base Attack Damage by 20%. All valid area targets still take 5% of your current Attack Damage as armor-respecting physical damage with no added knockback. Base cooldown: 12 seconds.
ui.martial_spells.demoralizing_shout_att: Attack Damage per Effect Level: -%s%% base
ui.martial_spells.demoralizing_shout_con: Debuff Health Limit: %s target max health
death.attack.martial_spells.demoralizing: %1$s was overwhelmed by a demoralizing shout
spell.martial_spells.throw_net.descripti: Charge and throw a weighted net that damages enemies and roots targets you can overpower.
spell.martial_spells.throw_net.guide: Hold to charge for up to 0.45 seconds, then release. Releases below 20% charge fizzle without a cooldown. Charge linearly extends projectile range from 10 to 22 blocks and scales damage/knockback output from 60% to 100%. A hit deals 10% of current Attack Damage at full charge. Targets whose maximum health is at most 100 + twice your current Attack Damage become Netted for 3 seconds: they cannot move, jump, or be knocked back, but can still attack, use items, and cast.
ui.martial_spells.throw_net_control_limi: Root Health Limit: %s target max health
death.attack.martial_spells.throw_net: %1$s was struck by a thrown net
spell.martial_spells.shattering_throw.de: Charge and hurl a visual copy of your held weapon, damaging enemies and shattering the armor of targets you can overpower.
spell.martial_spells.shattering_throw.gu: Hold to charge for up to 0.5 seconds, then release. Releases below 20% charge fizzle without a cooldown. Charge scales damage fully from 20% to 100% and extends projectile range from 14.4 to 24 blocks. The projectile uses a visual copy of your main-hand item, travels at 0.8 blocks per tick, homes slightly toward the release-time aim target, and can bounce from one block surface. A full-charge hit deals 100% of current Attack Damage before armor mitigation. Targets whose maximum health is at most 100 + twice your current Attack Damage gain Shattered Armor for 8 seconds, reducing base Armor by 30%.
ui.martial_spells.shattering_throw_contr: Shatter Health Limit: %s target max health
death.attack.martial_spells.shattering_t: %1$s was struck by a shattering weapon
effect.martial_spells.bleed.description: Losing health over time, worse while moving.
spell.martial_spells.mortal_strike.descr: Wind up a brutal vertical weapon strike that deals 50% bonus weapon damage and inflicts movement-scaled lethal Bleed.
spell.martial_spells.mortal_strike.guide: Wind up for 0.5 seconds, then perform a normal fully charged weapon attack in a 3-block, 120-degree vertical melee arc. The strike temporarily gains 50% total Attack Damage. Each struck living target receives 6 seconds of Bleed with amplifier 1 + floor(25% of Mortal Strike's temporarily boosted Attack Damage). Bleed deals lethal magic damage every 25 ticks: 0.5 damage per effective stack while stationary, scaling linearly up to 2 damage per stack at 2 blocks/second horizontal speed.
ui.martial_spells.mortal_strike_delay: Strike Contact: %s%% of melee attack cycle after release
effect.martial_spells.last_stand.descrip: Increases maximum health and knockback resistance.
spell.martial_spells.last_stand.descript: Stand your ground and channel defensive resolve, building up to five stacks of increased maximum health and knockback resistance while healing on each channel pulse.
spell.martial_spells.last_stand.guide: Channel for 2.5 seconds while rooted. Five pulses occur at 0.25, 0.75, 1.25, 1.75 and 2.25 seconds. Each pulse adds one Last Stand stack for 10 seconds, up to Last Stand V. Each effective stack grants +20% base maximum health and +20% base knockback resistance. After each new stack is applied, heal 10% of the newly increased current maximum health. Releasing early keeps earned stacks/healing and applies a proportional portion of the 60-second cooldown.
ui.martial_spells.last_stand_health: Per Stack: +%s%% base Max Health; max %s stacks
ui.martial_spells.last_stand_heal: Heal Per Pulse: %s%% of current Max Health
ui.martial_spells.last_stand_cooldown: Full Cooldown: %ss; proportional on early release
spell.martial_spells.flash_heal.descript: Rapidly restore a large amount of health to yourself or a friendly target.
spell.martial_spells.flash_heal.guide: A fast 0.5-second Holy cast that heals a friendly target within 16 blocks, falling back to the caster when no valid ally is selected.
spell.martial_spells.holy_shock.descript: Release holy power that heals a friendly target or damages an enemy.
spell.martial_spells.holy_shock.guide: Aim at a living target within 16 blocks. Friendly targets are healed; hostile targets take Holy spell damage and light knockback. With no target, Holy Shock heals the caster.
spell.martial_spells.circle_of_healing.d: Heal yourself and friendly targets in a wide area around you.
spell.martial_spells.circle_of_healing.g: After a 0.5-second Holy cast, heal yourself and friendly living targets within an 8-block horizontal radius and the source-equivalent reduced vertical range.
spell.martial_spells.blessed_strikes.des: Channel holy light into your weapon, storing seals that burst on successful melee strikes.
spell.martial_spells.blessed_strikes.gui: Channel for up to 2.5 seconds to gain five seals, one every 0.5 seconds. Each melee swing spends one seal after all same-tick Better Combat targets are struck and deals additional Holy damage.
effect.martial_spells.blessed_strikes.de: Your weapon is charged with holy light.
spell.martial_spells.divine_protection.d: Negate a limited number of incoming attacks for a short duration.
spell.martial_spells.divine_protection.g: Instantly gain Divine Protection for 8 seconds. Holy power determines whether the effect blocks one, two, or three incoming attacks; each blocked attack consumes one charge.
spell.martial_spells.judgement.descripti: Call down a holy judgement on a hostile target, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.
spell.martial_spells.judgement.guide: After a 0.5-second cast, a meteor descends from 12 blocks above the locked target at 1.2 blocks per tick. The 6-block impact uses squared distance falloff, deals hybrid melee/Holy damage, gains +50% power against undead, and stuns targets whose max health is at most 50 + twice your Attack Damage.
ui.martial_spells.judgement_control_limi: Stun Health Limit: %s target max health
spell.martial_spells.immolation.descript: Erupt in holy fire, burning nearby enemies while healing yourself and nearby allies.
spell.martial_spells.immolation.guide: Instantly affects a 5-block area with half-height vertical reach. Allies are healed; enemies take Holy damage and burn for 4 seconds. Undead receive the source +50% power bonus and guaranteed default critical multiplier.
spell.martial_spells.holy_beam.descripti: Channel a beam of holy light that heals allies and damages enemies in your aim.
spell.martial_spells.holy_beam.guide: Channel for up to 5 seconds. Twenty-five midpoint pulses trace your current aim out to 32 blocks. Friendly targets are healed and hostile targets take Holy damage; every pulse preserves Spell Engine's 0.2-second channel multiplier. Releasing early keeps completed pulses and applies proportional mana and cooldown.
spell.martial_spells.levitate.descriptio: Channel holy light to rise into the air, then drift gently back down.
spell.martial_spells.levitate.guide: Channel for up to 1.5 seconds while horizontally rooted. Four source-timed releases reset your motion to a +0.15 vertical lift and refresh Levitate for 5 seconds. Levitate maintains vanilla Slow Falling using the frozen 1.20.1 refresh rule; the remaining soft-fall time after Levitate ends depends on when that refresh occurred. Releasing early applies proportional mana and cooldown.
effect.martial_spells.levitate.descripti: You drift gently through the air.
spell.martial_spells.penance.description: Channel three homing holy bolts into an enemy, shielding nearby allies as each bolt lands.
spell.martial_spells.penance.guide: Lock a hostile target within 20 blocks and channel for up to 1.5 seconds. Three midpoint releases fire 0.8-speed homing bolts with a 16-degree-per-tick turn cap. Each hit deals the source-normalized Holy damage and radiates a no-falloff absorption pulse to allies within 8 blocks for 6 seconds. Releasing early applies proportional mana and cooldown.
Absorbs some damage you would take.
spell.martial_spells.barrier.description: Summon a circular holy barrier that protects allies from projectiles, magic, explosions, and hostile intruders.
spell.martial_spells.barrier.guide: After a 0.5-second Holy cast, create an 8-block-wide, 4-block-tall barrier for 10 seconds. Allies inside receive continuously refreshed protection from player attacks, explosions, and magic; friendly projectiles pass through while hostile projectiles collide, and hostile creatures inside are pushed outward.
spell.martial_spells.battle_banner.descr: Plant a radiant banner that empowers nearby allies with faster attacks, spellcasting, and ranged attacks while improving knockback resistance.
spell.martial_spells.battle_banner.guide: Instantly plant a banner 2 blocks ahead for a 10-second active phase, bracketed by its 43-tick placement and removal phases. Every 0.5 seconds it refreshes a 2-second buff on allies in its power-scaled radius, granting +40% base Attack Speed, Knockback Resistance, Iron's cast/cooldown haste, and RangedWeaponAPI draw speed.
spell.martial_spells.lightwell.descripti: Summon a stationary Lightwell that repeatedly sends holy motes to wounded nearby allies.
spell.martial_spells.lightwell.guide: Place a Lightwell 1.5 blocks ahead. After its 1-second spawn phase it heals wounded friendly targets within 12 blocks for 12 seconds, then spends 1 second despawning. Each heal is delivered by a 1.0-speed Holy Mote that launches upward, begins homing after 15% of its initial target distance, turns up to 16 degrees per tick, can bounce once, and heals for 35% of the well's translated healing power. The Lightwell spell itself always has a fixed 45-second cooldown.
spell.martial_spells.lightwell_orb.descr: Internal Lightwell helper that delivers a homing healing orb to a wounded ally.
effect.martial_spells.battle_banner.desc: Attack speed, spell haste, ranged haste, and knockback resistance are increased.
